title: Japanese Curry Fish Balls
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of Japan with the spices of Saudi Arabia. This recipe is a unique take on traditional Japanese curry.

ingredients.name: Fish Balls (made from fish and saudi arabian spices)

instructions: Prepare the Japanese Curry Powder by mixing it with Arabian Spices and a pinch of sugar.
Heat the curry mixture with Coconut Milk and Soy Sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cut the Fish Balls into bite-sized pieces and add them to the curry sauce.
Simmer the curry sauce for 5-7 minutes or until the fish balls are cooked through.
Serve the curry sauce over a bed of steamed Rice.
Garnish with sliced Green Onions and a sprinkle of curry powder.
